# BLAS

![BLAS function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/00_BLAS.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Browse 35 native BLAS operations in the documented order: 14 vector and rotation operations, 12 matrix/vector operations and 9 matrix/matrix operations. Matrix and general Linear Algebra retain their own palettes.

No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: operation_a=0, matrix_a_type=3, diagonal=0. |

No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: a=zero_square_length_x, alpha=1, matrix_a_type=3. |
| [dsyr2](../../math/linear_algebra/blas/dsyr2.md) | Updates only the chosen triangle of A + alpha*x*y^T + alpha*y*x^T; keeps the rest of A. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: a=zero_square_length_x, alpha=1, matrix_a_type=3. |
| [zher](../../math/linear_algebra/blas/zher.md) | Updates the chosen triangle of A + alpha*x*x^H, with DBL real alpha and a real computed diagonal. A is required and covers at least the NxN calculated block; the rest is preserved. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. NI input says NxN but output describes remaining cells. GS requires A (no NI omitted-A default) and accepts A at least NxN, preserving every cell outside the selected triangle/block. Optional unwired defaults: alpha=1, matrix_a_type=3. |

No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: a=zero_square_length_x, alpha=1, matrix_a_type=3. |

No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: a=zero_matrix_length_x_by_length_y, alpha=1. |

No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: a=zero_matrix_length_x_by_length_y, alpha=1. |
| [zgerc](../../math/linear_algebra/blas/zgerc.md) | Updates the leading rectangular block of A + alpha*x*y^H; conjugation is on y, not x. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: a=zero_matrix_length_x_by_length_y, alpha=1. |

No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. NI omitted-C default not documented; C required GS. Optional unwired defaults: alpha=1, beta=1, operation_a=0, operation_b=0. |

DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: c=zero_matrix_shape_b, alpha=1, beta=1, side=1, matrix_a_type=3. |

No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: c=zero_matrix_shape_b, alpha=1, beta=1, side=1, matrix_a_type=3. |
| [trmm](../../math/linear_algebra/blas/trmm.md) | B = alpha*op(U(A))*B (Left), or alpha*B*op(U(A)) (Right). No beta or C accumulator; B retains its shape. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: alpha=1, side=1, operation_a=0, matrix_a_type=3, diagonal=0. |
| [syrk](../../math/linear_algebra/blas/syrk.md) | Updates only the chosen C triangle using alpha*A*A^T + beta*C or alpha*A^T*A + beta*C. No conjugation. C is required; complex H is explicitly rejected. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. C required: no NI omitted-C default certified. Complex H enum value1 rejected; N0/T2 implement symmetric standard BLAS. Real value1 equals transpose. Optional unwired defaults: alpha=1, beta=1, operation_a=0, matrix_c_type=3. |
| [syr2k](../../math/linear_algebra/blas/syr2k.md) | Updates only the chosen C triangle using alpha*A*B^T + alpha*B*A^T + beta*C, or its transposed form. No conjugation. C is required; complex H is rejected. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. C required: no NI omitted-C default certified. Complex H enum value1 rejected; N0/T2 implement symmetric standard BLAS. Real value1 equals transpose. Optional unwired defaults: alpha=1, beta=1, operation=0, matrix_c_type=3. |
| [zherk](../../math/linear_algebra/blas/zherk.md) | Updates only the chosen C triangle using alpha*A*A^H + beta*C or alpha*A^H*A + beta*C. Both alpha and beta are DBL real. N/H supported; T is explicitly rejected. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. N0/H1 only; NI enum T2 exists but its mathematical adaptation is not documented, so GS refuses T2 rather than changing it to H. Optional unwired defaults: c=zero_square_rows_op_a, alpha=1, beta=1, operation_a=0, matrix_c_type=3. |
| [zher2k](../../math/linear_algebra/blas/zher2k.md) | Updates only the chosen C triangle using alpha*A*B^H + conj(alpha)*B*A^H + beta*C, or its adjoint form. Alpha CDB, beta DBL. N/H supported; T is rejected. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. N0/H1 only; NI enum T2 exists but its mathematical adaptation is not documented, so GS refuses T2 rather than changing it to H. Optional unwired defaults: c=zero_square_rows_op_a, alpha=1, beta=1, operation=0, matrix_c_type=3. |
| [trsm](../../math/linear_algebra/blas/trsm.md) | Solves op(U(A))*result=alpha*x (Left), or result*op(U(A))=alpha*x (Right); x is a matrix. No explicit inverse is formed. DBL/CDB instance domains and full Array ranks are explicit; permitted narrower numeric inputs are promoted visibly. A real-only port never discards an imaginary part. No broadcasting or implicit Matrix conversion. Outputs own their data; error is I32, without automatic popup. Optional unwired defaults: alpha=1, side=1, operation_a=0, matrix_a_type=3, diagonal=0. |

## Types and Compatibility

The notes below retain the reviewed help's original NI and Studio scopes. An NI overload is not a claim of Studio runtime support; the authoring profile and execution limits remain separate.

DBL/CDB profiles use existing rank-one and rank-two Arrays; exact signatures and target admission remain per operation.
